title: Poseidon Baseline Comparison
purpose: Establish fair comparison between CIPHER-PU (xcau25p, N=2^12) and Poseidon (Alveo U280, HPCA 2023) as the strongest FPGA baseline for Q1 SCI submission.

open_source_status.note: Poseidon paper does not release RTL code. Cross-verification via EFFACT Table VI, Anaheim HPCA'25, Cheddar 2024, FlexMem.

absolute_throughput.note: Poseidon wins on absolute throughput, driven by 5-7x larger hardware and 170x more power.

energy_efficiency.note: CIPHER-PU has 20.5x higher energy efficiency in samples/s/W.

per_lut_efficiency.note: Poseidon is 28% better per-LUT but requires HBM + higher frequency.

poseidon_scaled_to_N_2pow12.conclusion: Even at same N=2^12, Poseidon would use 1.6x more LUT than CIPHER-PU.

cipher_pu_scaled_to_N_2pow14.conclusion: CIPHER-PU cannot fit N=2^14 on xcau25p; needs U280/xck260 for large N.

key_findings: Poseidon is the strongest FPGA baseline (HPCA 2023, 139 citations).
Absolute throughput: Poseidon wins 8.2x (14,031 vs 1,702 samples/s).
Energy efficiency: CIPHER-PU wins 20.5x in samples/s/W (1,440 vs 70.2).
Per-LUT throughput: Poseidon wins 1.28x, but at 6.4x more LUTs + HBM.
CIPHER-PU is 6.4x smaller, 170x lower power, no HBM requirement.
Runtime adaptivity and DARE bootstrap-lite are CIPHER-PU unique contributions.
Positioning: Poseidon for data-center; CIPHER-PU for edge/IoT low-power.
paper_writing_guidance: Section 7.6: State clearly that CIPHER-PU targets edge scenarios while Poseidon targets data-center.
DO NOT claim 'CIPHER-PU throughput exceeds Poseidon' (will be rebutted).
CAN claim 'CIPHER-PU 20.5x energy efficiency vs Poseidon for edge IoT use cases'.
Appendix: Cite Poseidon source chain (HPCA'23 + EFFACT 2025 + Anaheim HPCA'25 + Cheddar 2024).
limitations: Poseidon RTL not open-source; cannot do same-device direct comparison.
Poseidon clock frequency not officially reported; estimated from EFFACT/Anaheim.
HELR samples/s = batch_size / iteration_time assumes uniform batch processing.
CIPHER-PU 1.182 W is XPower static estimate, +/- 20% possible without SAIF.
data_source_reliability: high (3 independent sources for Poseidon benchmarks, primary reports for CIPHER-PU)
